newsitem.title: UK: LPC - First for Russian gold project financing.
newsitem.headline: LPC - First for Russian gold project financing.

text.p: LONDON, July 30 (LPC) - Standard Bank London has launched syndication of a fully underwritten $40 million project financing for Omusukschank Mining & Geological Co, which funds the development of a high-grade gold mine in the Magadan province of eastern Russia, bankers said on Wednesday.
The borrower is majority owned by Ariane Resources Corp of Toronto, which has provided a completion guarantee.
The deal is priced at 450 basis points over LIBOR and has political risk insurance from the World Bank acting through MIGA.
The tenor of the financing is 4.5 years and repayment is in five equal semi-annual instalments once construction is complete.

Bankers said the deal is believed to be the first Russian project financing to be launched on a stand-alone basis without the umbrella of the IFC or EBRD and is also the first Russian project where the contractors -- TIC of Denver and Jacobs Mincorp -- have provided a fixed price construction contract.
Previous contractors have been reluctant to offer such assurances as projects in the region have been notoriously prone to heavy infrastructure cost overruns.
The arranger commented that in this instance, the relatively small scale and high quality of the project encouraged the contractors to specify a price.
